CustomField.description: BACKEND-ONLY. Single-use token populated on Lead create when no IC Service Appointment exists yet, by the Lead_Generate_IC_Schedule_Token record-triggered flow (which calls LeadICScheduleTokenStamper). Used to build IC_Schedule_Link__c so an AC / marketing user can share an initial-call booking link with the family. Cleared by GuestSchedulerController after a successful first-time IC schedule so the link cannot be re-used.
CustomField.label: IC Schedule Token
